items.title: Matthew Golden: Career-high receiving yards in win
items.text:
Golden brought in all 10 targets for 164 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Tallies 13 touches in Week 9
items.text:
Price posted nine carries for 24 yards and secured all four targets for 54 yards during Sunday's 17-3 victory versus the Cardinals.

items.title: Christian Watson: Career-high yardage total in win

items.title: Jordan Love: Another prolific performance in win
items.text:
Love completed 23 of 29 passes for 372 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed once for a 13-yard score in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.
